Standing defect holds: with audit_max_rounds=0 the payload emits max_rounds:null and rounds_remaining:null but omits budget_exhausted - three keys of one group, two shapes.

TestAuditStatus_Shapes pins the empty-state shape ([] not null for audit_rounds), the --check exit codes for converged and stale, and the absence of mechanical_checks; TestAuditRecordStatus_FlagRejections pins six exit-2 combinations. Nothing here pins max_rounds, rounds_remaining or budget_exhausted, which is why the uncapped asymmetry named on the audit_record.go row is unguarded.
